title: Springy Toggle
summary: A switch whose knob stretches as it travels.
description: A switch whose knob stretches as it travels.
accessibility_notes: Every micro-interaction must have a non-animated equivalent: state changes are announced through ARIA, not through motion.
ai_usage: Settings toggles. The knob widening on press is the detail that makes a switch feel physical; keep the travel spring under 350ms so it never feels sluggish.
source:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <title>Springy Toggle</title>
  <script type="application/json" id="effect-meta">
  {
    "id": "toggle-switch-spring",
    "title": "Springy Toggle",
    "summary": "A switch whose knob stretches as it travels.",
    "description": "A switch whose knob stretches as it travels.",
    "theme": "micro-interactions",
    "categories": ["micro-interaction", "feedback"],
    "tags": ["micro-interaction", "feedback", "toggle", "switch", "spring", "press"],
    "tech": ["css"],
    "era": "2020s",
    "difficulty": "intermediate",
    "dependencies": [],
    "browser_support": "All modern browsers (Chromium, Firefox, Safari).",
    "performance_notes": "Lightweight — composited transform/opacity work only.",
    "accessibility_notes": "Every micro-interaction must have a non-animated equivalent: state changes are announced through ARIA, not through motion.",
    "customization": [
      { "name": "--on", "description": "On colour", "default": "#10a894" }
    ],
    "variations": ["Adapt to a light theme", "Add a compact variant"],
    "ai_usage": "Settings toggles. The knob widening on press is the detail that makes a switch feel physical; keep the travel spring under 350ms so it never feels sluggish."
  }
  </script>
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
    html, body { height: 100%; margin: 0; }
    body { display: grid; place-items: center; background: #0b0d12; color: #e7ebf3;
      font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; overflow: hidden; }
    .fx { position: relative; width: 62px; height: 34px; border-radius: 99px; border: 0; background: #2b3450; cursor: pointer;
      transition: background .25s; }
    .fx::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 4px; left: 4px; width: 26px; height: 26px; border-radius: 99px;
      background: #fff; transition: transform .32s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1), width .2s; }
    .fx[aria-pressed="true"] { background: #10a894; }
    .fx[aria-pressed="true"]::after { transform: translateX(28px); }
    .fx:active::after { width: 32px; }
    .fx:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7c5cff; outline-offset: 3px; }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      * { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <button class="fx" type="button" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="Enable notifications" id="tg"></button>
  <script>
    (function () {
      var b = document.getElementById("tg");
      b.addEventListener("click", function () {
        b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", b.getAttribute("aria-pressed") === "true" ? "false" : "true");
      });
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
